name: Logo Maker
description: Type a name and your AI designs four logo ideas in the style you pick. Monograms with your initials appear instantly.
prompt: A logo maker: type a brand name, what it does and a style, and the AI designs four different SVG logo concepts, plus instant monograms with the initials, favourites and saving logos as PNG.
author: gonzaroman

description_i18n.es: Escribe un nombre y tu IA diseña cuatro ideas de logo en el estilo que elijas. Los monogramas con tus iniciales salen al instante.
